progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb3 and dwells most on C in Molla Nazi. The line peaks at Eb4 (305.7 Hz) at 0:15.1. It closes on Ak3, not the tonic (Bb3 → Ak3 → Eb4 → G3 → C4 → Ak3).
